key_concepts: A force is a push or a pull that acts on an object due to interaction with another object.
Forces can change an object's shape and size.
Forces can make a stationary object move.
Forces can speed up, slow down, or stop a moving object.
Forces can change the direction of a moving object.
Forces are classified as contact forces and non-contact forces.
Contact forces include applied force, tension, friction, and normal force.
Non-contact forces include gravity, electrostatic force, and magnetic force.
Gravity pulls objects downward, while water exerts an upward buoyant force.
Air resistance affects the fall of objects, as seen with crumpled and uncrumpled paper.
A spring balance or improvised force measurer can measure force by spring displacement.
The SI unit of force is the newton (N).
